name: zclass_world_set_pending_fog_density
description: zClass_World::SetPendingFogDensity stores pending fog density and marks the pending density flag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this world fog setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450b60 validates storing the float argument to world class-data offset 0x30, OR-ing pending flag 0x08, and returning 0.
The native world fog smoke verifies pending density storage participates in the aggregate pending flag mask and downstream fog application.
